reason: SolidForge is primarily an orchestration plugin for coding-agent workflows, combining parallel implementation, structured planning, deterministic validation, adversarial review, and convergence controls.

summaries.zh: SolidForge 为编码代理提供双环收敛、并行实现、结构化评审和确定性验证的工作流编排能力。
summaries.en: SolidForge orchestrates coding-agent workflows with parallel implementation, structured review, deterministic validation, and dual-loop convergence controls.

capabilities: Installs an agent preset and optional global plugin surface
Orchestrates multi-agent coding workflows and parallel implementation
Runs deterministic gates, tests, state-machine controls, rollback, and convergence records
Supports subprocess-based heterogeneous review through external model routing
Can modify and validate target project files during implementation workflows
